title: Full-Stack Developer 2026 — Deep Dives
subtitle: Hand-authored, code-first masterclasses that supplement the 37-phase source curriculum with slower executable teaching.

tracks.title: JavaScript Core — From Syntax to Runtime Reasoning
tracks.description: Learn JavaScript by predicting behavior, running small programs, debugging incorrect assumptions, and gradually building TaskFlow Lite.

tracks.title: TypeScript — Make Invalid States Harder to Represent
tracks.description: Move from working JavaScript to explicit compile-time contracts, then learn where runtime validation must take over.

tracks.title: React — State, Rendering, and Component Design
tracks.description: Build TaskFlow Lite in React while learning state ownership, derived data, forms, effects, and composition.

tracks.title: Next.js — App Router, Server/Client Boundaries, and Production Rendering
tracks.description: Build the actual TaskFlow web shell and reason precisely about what runs on the server, what ships to the browser, and how routing affects data flow.

tracks.title: NestJS + Fastify — Request Lifecycle and Backend Architecture
tracks.description: Trace an HTTP request through Fastify and NestJS, then build modules/controllers/services with clear ownership.

tracks.title: PostgreSQL + Prisma — Data Modeling, SQL, and Migrations
tracks.description: Learn the database independently, then use Prisma without surrendering understanding of SQL and migration risk.

tracks.title: Authentication + Authorization — Identity, Trust, and Permissions
tracks.description: Separate proving identity from deciding permission, then attack your own assumptions.

tracks.title: Forms + TanStack Query — Professional Frontend Data Flow
tracks.description: Build reliable forms, cache server state, handle mutations, and reason about optimistic concurrency.

tracks.title: Testing + Security + Observability + Performance
tracks.description: Turn production quality into observable, testable engineering rather than a checklist.

tracks.title: Docker + GitHub Actions + Production Deployment
tracks.description: Package, verify, release, deploy, smoke-test, and roll back TaskFlow with explicit evidence at every stage.
